text:
mei: Heads-up: after the q4-packager rollout we see ZWJ/zero-width joiner disappearing in zh->he short-context samples. BLEU not great but more concerning is grammatical reordering in Hebrew output. :confused:

jon: can you paste a tiny repro? thought zwj handling was stable for q4 bringups.

mei: small repro below. Run on sora-lite-q4 with packer v1.2.0. Behavior not present on packer v1.1.7.

```
python eval/run_locale_eval.py --model sora-lite-q4 --quant-profile q4_packed --pairs zh-he --samples 300 --shortctx --shuffle-seed 42
```

mei: Example source / reference / model output (detok) from failing run: 

```
# source (zh): 我们·是·一家小型企业（注：包含ZWJ）
# reference (he): אנחנו חברה קטנה • (הערה: כולל ZWJ)
# model out (detok): אנחנוחברה קטנה • (הערה:כולל)
# note: missing spacing around ZWJ and punctuation, token boundary lost before hebrew clause
```

arjun: looks like ZWJ turned into an invisible merge with preceding han cluster and then got stripped by post-detok cleanup. Any token-id diffs?

mei: dug into the token map dump: packer v1.2.0 introduced a compact remap that collapses "+ZWJ" suffix entries into the base codepoint to save table space. snippet below: 

```
# remap excerpt (v1.1.7)
U+200D (ZWJ) -> tok_9001
U+4E00 (CJK-1) -> tok_9002
U+200D+4E00 -> tok_9100 (separate entry)

# remap excerpt (v1.2.0)
U+200D (ZWJ) -> tok_9001
U+4E00 (CJK-1) -> tok_9002
# composite entries collapsed => no U+200D+4E00 mapping
```

jon: collapsing composites could be okay for most western scripts but not for mixed CJK+ZWJ semantics. That explains the missing boundary and subsequent detok join. Did the packer change note mention composite collapsing?

mei: the changelog item said "reduce remap table size via suffix coalescing" but didn't call out ZWJ or bidi-sensitive scripts.

nora: infra-bot: packer v1.2.0 deployed to hosted yesterday 6950000000. infra-bot: recommended mitigation -> roll forward packer flag to preserve composite entries for locales in set {zh, ja, ko, he, ar}.

infra-bot: canary job created 6950001120 -> packer-flag-mitigate-zwj (hosts: canary-xx). Link: https://ci.redwood.local/canaries/6950001120

arjun: Short-term fixes: 1) toggle preserve-composites flag for affected locales (fast). 2) revert packer globally to v1.1.7 if the flag isn't safe. 3) add unit test asserting composite token presence for curated CJK+RTL seeds.

jon: agree. Also add a regression eval that measures token-boundary F1 between raw tokenization and detok for mixed-script samples. That will catch silent merges.

mei: I've started a PR with a small test corpus (zwj_cjk_he_seed.txt) and a tokenizer assertion. PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/ml/tokenizer/pull/812 (WIP).

eval-bot: scheduled job 6950001130: locale-detok-boundary-zh-he-f1 (1000 samples). Results will post to the regression dashboard in ~2h.

nora: I'll draft a short internal note for SRE and Support so we can field any customer reports about spacing/punctuation regressions in CJK->RTL routes. No external comms yet until mitigations verified.

jon: thanks. if the canary flag looks good, let's promote it to dedicated next maintenance window. Also add a lint rule in packager CI to refuse suffix-coalescing PRs that don't whitelist ZWJ/ZWSP combos.

mei: will add the whitelist and the test. assigning: mei -> PR + repro artifacts (ETA 2h), arjun -> token-boundary F1 eval dashboard (ETA 3h), nora -> canary rollout + support note (ETA 1.5h), jon -> CI lint rule in packager (ETA 4h).

jon: good catch, mei. keep updates here. :white_check_mark:
